Control Objective: Ensure cybersecurity policies are documented and reviewed regularly
Current State: Policies exist but annual review evidence is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Current security policies and policy review records
Recommended Action: Establish an annual policy review cycle and retain approval evidence

Control Objective: Define cybersecurity roles and accountability across departments
Current State: Security responsibilities exist but are not fully documented
Recommended Action: Create a formal cybersecurity RACI matrix

Control Objective: Maintain a formal cybersecurity risk management process
Current State: A risk register is maintained and reviewed
Evidence Expected: Risk register and review meeting records
Recommended Action: Continue recurring risk reviews and management reporting

Control Objective: Assign owners to identified cybersecurity risks
Current State: Risk ownership is documented for some but not all risks
Recommended Action: Assign a risk owner to every High and Medium risk

Control Objective: Document approval for accepted cybersecurity risk
Evidence Expected: Risk acceptance forms and management approvals
Recommended Action: Create a formal risk acceptance workflow

Control Objective: Manage cybersecurity risk from vendors and service providers
Current State: Vendor assessments occur but reassessment is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Vendor questionnaires risk ratings and reassessment records
Recommended Action: Implement annual reassessments for high-risk vendors

Control Objective: Track cybersecurity compliance obligations and responsibilities
Recommended Action: Maintain a compliance obligations register with accountable owners

Control Objective: Maintain an inventory of organizational systems and assets
Current State: A current asset inventory is maintained

Control Objective: Identify threats vulnerabilities and business risks
Restrict system access according to business need
Current State: Role-based access controls are implemented but reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Access review reports and approval records
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Current State: Annual security awareness training is provided
Recommended Action: Continue annual training and phishing simulations

Control Objective: Remediate vulnerabilities according to risk and severity
Current State: Vulnerability scanning occurs but some findings exceed remediation targets

Control Objective: Collect security logs from critical systems
Evidence Expected: SIEM dashboards and log source inventory

Control Objective: Review alert and detection coverage regularly
Current State: Detection rules exist but formal coverage reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Detection rule inventory and coverage review records

Control Objective: Maintain a documented incident response plan
Current State: A documented incident response plan exists
Recommended Action: Review the incident response plan annually

Control Objective: Validate incident response procedures through exercises
Current State: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Evidence Expected: Tabletop exercise reports and lessons learned
Recommended Action: Conduct annual incident response tabletop exercises

Control Objective: Maintain reliable backups for critical systems
Verify backups can be successfully restored
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly restoration testing and retain evidence
